name: @codeauradev/ngx-signal-storage
description: Angular 22 signals for localStorage, sessionStorage, and cookies.

scripts.build: ng-packagr -p ng-package.json && node --input-type=module -e "import {readFileSync,writeFileSync} from 'node:fs'; const file='dist/package.json'; const pkg=JSON.parse(readFileSync(file,'utf8')); delete pkg.main; delete pkg.types; writeFileSync(file, JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2)+'\n');"
scripts.publish: npm run build && cd dist && npm publish
